title: Retries, Idempotency & Exactly-once Semantics
interviewAnswer: Distributed operations fail partially. Retries are safe only when operations are idempotent or deduplicated. “Exactly once” usually means carefully defined processing/commit semantics rather than packets literally delivered once.
why: Retries, Idempotency & Exactly-once Semantics appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.
deepDive: Distributed operations fail partially. Retries are safe only when operations are idempotent or deduplicated. “Exactly once” usually means carefully defined processing/commit semantics rather than packets literally delivered once.
